## Review checklist

- [ ] Readable: a beginner can follow each changed file from top to bottom
- [ ] Tested: unit tests for security-critical changes; manual checks noted
- [ ] No new Flatpak permissions (or each one is explained in docs/security.md)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal URLs in code, logs or tests
- [ ] Docs updated (README, docs/security.md, CHANGELOG.md)
- [ ] Targets `staging`, not `main`
